ammonia.reason: Young washed-curd with limited deamination by lactococci yields very low NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and no washed-rind bacteria gives no p-cresol/indole barnyard.

bitter.reason: Curd washing removes lactose and bitter peptides; low chymosin bitterness at pH 5.46.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti and methyl ketones <1 mg/kg gives no blue character.

browning.reason: Moderate residual galactose/lactose plus lysine drives Maillard on heating with good melt.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus citrate metabolism makes diacetyl then reduced to acetoin 97.7 mg/kg.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipolysis with free butanoic acid <1 mg/kg gives only faint sweaty.

creaminess.reason: 41.6% moisture and 27.8% fat with elastic washed-curd matrix gives moderate creaminess.

crumbliness.reason: Low-cooked elastic casein network with intact calcium phosphate does not fracture.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard 41.6% moisture, pH 5.46, light pressing and wax rind gives firm-elastic body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde <1 mg/kg gives trace floral.

fruity.reason: Esterase esterification of ethanol 185.8 mg/kg to ethyl butanoate/hexanoate <1 mg/kg.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks goaty branched 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids from goat fat.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine/isoleucine Strecker to 2-/3-methylbutanal plus propionic gives mild nutty.

melt.reason: Washed-curd demineralization at pH 5.46 loosens casein for smooth flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from mold lipoxygenase in interior-ripened block.

oil_off.reason: Moderate 27.8% fat in stable emulsion releases only light free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: Not smoked and no guaiacol/phenols from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Heterofermentative NSLAB and Lactococcus produce acetic acid 54.4 mg/kg.

stretch.reason: Rennet gel without pasta-filata hot-stretch alignment flows rather than strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low-heat cook ~35-37C and no thermophilic sulfur amino acid catabolism to methanethiol.

sweet.reason: Washed-curd low acid, 1.43% salt, acetoin and proline/glycine give sweet-mild balance.

umami.reason: Rennet plus Lactococcus peptidases release moderate glutamate in 1-3 mo proteolysis.
